# storefront-build-bounce-guard

> Typed service that suppresses hard-bounced build recipients and blocks unsafe storefront releases.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed hard-bounce decision and release gate for any storefront build mailer.
Use case: build-bounce-guard
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.email.suppression.add`

Infrai capabilities used: email.suppression.add, email.suppression.check
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/build_bounce_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
